summary.text: Stefani L. Zinerman represents Brooklyn's 56th Assembly District, which covers Bedford-Stuyvesant and Crown Heights, and has served since her election in 2020.
Her official biography says she chairs the Subcommittee on Emerging Workforce and was appointed Deputy Majority Whip by Speaker Carl Heastie.

paragraphs.text: Zinerman is a third-generation Bedford-Stuyvesant resident, according to her Assembly biography.
It lists her legislation as including the Community Hiring Act and the Plain Language Bill, which simplifies ballot proposals for voters.
It also says she secured $6 million for a new Bed-Stuy Volunteer Ambulance Corps facility that will include the district's first birthing center.
She is a member of the Black, Puerto Rican, Hispanic and Asian Legislative Caucus and the Legislative Women's Caucus, and is vice president of the New York State Black Legislative Taskforce.

Outside the Legislature she leads the Underground Reading Railroad literacy program and the youth civic education curriculum Power Up, and supports Age Friendly Central Brooklyn, Inc., according to the biography.
